notes.title: The "Demon Lord" Final version (V1.0.10) released
notes.content:
We are honored to announce that [b]Demon Lord[/b] is leaving Early Access and officially launching today (Mar 21st, 2017). Thank you for your long-time support!

In the final version we want to give users more fun and better experience. Modifications of the game:

[h1][b] Version 1.0.10 (Final version): [/b][/h1]
　　Added 3 game endings.

[h1][b] Version 1.0.09: [/b][/h1]
　　Added the resolution options.
　　Fixed the Bug of the last level can not return.

[h1][b] Version 1.0.08: [/b][/h1]
　　Adjusted the complexity of Level.
　　Adjusted the random tasks.

[h1][b] Version 1.0.07: [/b][/h1]
　　Optimized the task prompts.

Thank you for your support and cooperation, If you are in the Final version and find any bus, We will be in the subsequent version of the maintenance update,  We hope to optimize the content to bring you a different experience!

Thank you again for your support and love for the "Demon Lord" !

Thank you!

Yours,
GalaxyGameStudio
